description: Run tests on Firebase Test Lab. Uploads an APK and test APK, executes instrumented tests across specified device models and API levels. Requires gcloud CLI authenticated with a Firebase project.

appApk.description: Path to the app APK file

devices.description: Device specs as 'model=DEVICE,version=API' (e.g., 'model=bluejay,version=33'). Omit for default device.

execTimeoutMs.description: Local execFile timeout for the gcloud invocation in ms (1min-60min, default 10min). Y4 fix: bigger device matrices or larger APKs can plausibly exceed the previous hardcoded 10min.

resultsBucket.description: GCS bucket for results (omit for default)

testApk.description: Path to the test/instrumentation APK file

testTargets.description: Specific test class or method (e.g., 'class com.example.MyTest')

timeout.description: Test timeout passed to gcloud --timeout (e.g., '300s', '10m'). This is the LAB-side timeout.

name: adb_farm_run
